Not run live.\\n\\nShape: one task, one small pull request, not stacked. 71b8826c (a draft about a missing archived-project check in the same method) goes right after the project resolves and this check goes after the pull-request read, so they touch different lines, neither changes the other\\u0027s behaviour, and neither blocks the other.\\n\\nThe daemon refuses this case at both of its checkout sites, before any fetch: src/Hall9k.Daemon/Execution/RunLauncher.cs:243-271 and 1156-1173. A bare number passes no repository, so gh answers from the checkout\\u0027s default repository, which in a fork checkout can be upstream while the worktree still fetches from origin. No new helper is needed. Do not use PullRequestUrls.NamesForeignRepository: it also compares hosts, so a project recorded with an SSH host alias (git@github-work:you/project.git, which h9k project add accepts) would have its own pull requests refused. The host needs no check here, because GitHubPullRequestReference.RepositoryFromUrl already refuses anything off github.com. The project\\u0027s URL is project.RepositoryUrl, falling back to GitHubWorkItemProvider.TryObserveRepositoryHostAsync through the same processRunner the read uses, as RunLauncher.cs:256-258 does. RunLauncher.OwnerRepoFrom is internal to the daemon and stays as it is; this task does not switch the daemon over.\\n\\nAccepted consequence: a renamed repository whose recorded URL is stale is refused, even on a bare number, because gh answers with the new name (observed on a renamed public repository) and h9k project set has no option to correct a recorded URL. The daemon already refuses automated reviews on such a project, so only the hand lap changes, and it fails with a clear message. This is parked rather than solved here.\\n\\nRunAsync already takes its gh and git seams as parameters for tests. tests/Hall9k.Tests/Integration/ReviewLapTests.cs has no case for this. Its ScriptedGh (line 1882) answers every call with the same pull-request JSON, so the fourth criterion needs a scripted gh that answers gh repo view separately.
